description.value: Uncle Fatih's Pizza is a Vancouver pizza counter on West 8th Avenue offering both delivery and quick takeout service. Located on a busy urban street near Main Street, it operates late into the night and accepts multiple payment types including cash. A convenient spot for cyclists looking for a hot meal or slice in the Cambie–Main corridor.
